title: The Children
description: Gas leaking from a nuclear-power plant turns children into zombies who burn those they touch.

title: The Offing
description: Neviah, a tormented recluse, and Freya, an enigmatic stranger, embark on a scenic road trip that spirals into chaos. Struggling to outrun the past, their friendship is tested at every turn, with all roads leading to a shocking revelation.

description:

A compilation of snack-sized horror films.

title: Bloody Bites
description:

Awakening on the floor of a destroyed suburban bedroom, a global invasion has begun, and the protagonist is not alone in the house; after the death of her dog Max, a pet influencer is confronted by a vengeful spirit demanding an apology.

title: Bloody Bites
description:
S05 E03 — The Bloody Ballad of Squirt Reynolds, Cupcake
Counselors at a campfire tell the tale of Squirt Reynolds, a killer in a Burt Reynolds mask; a couple kills the wrong man with poisoned cupcakes.

description:

description:

title: Bloody Bites
description:

A guy with guts outside his body vies for a promotion; wondering where missing socks go; tensions rise for four retirees stuck in an elevator.

description:
